messages:
lia: heads-up: pushing a soft-pin request for runtime v2.15 on canary. we saw semantic drift in reranker outputs after the recent model+sdk shuffle in ap-south-1 — embeddings cosine dropped ~0.07 vs baseline. requesting hold on unpin until we confirm no quality regressions. @deploybot please stop auto-unpin for cohorts receiving v2.15 for now.

sam: can you confirm which change likely caused this? is it the runtime tweak or the model packaging?

lia: it looks correlated to runtime v2.15 + sdk-adapter@1.3.0 combo. model artifact (reranker-v3.1) rolled at 2024-03-12T11:05Z, runtime v2.15 promoted at 11:08Z. similarity drop aligns with that minute.

devops-bot: deploybot: Received request: hold-unpin runtime v2.15 for canary. Checking active routes and pinlist...

devops-bot: deploybot: canary cohorts: ap-south-1, us-west-2-night. runtime:v2.15 currently partially rolled. Action requires ops-ack and at least one release lead confirmation.

release-coordinator: adding to release window notes: soft-pin requested. target observation: 45m. we'll update release notes if we decide to roll back.

sre-oncall: ack. I'll watch the quality dashboards (embedding-sim, rerank-ctr) and set a temporary alert: embedding-cosine-drop >0.04 sustained for 10m -> notify.

sam: propose concrete gates:
- quality gate: avg embedding cosine (top-10) drop >0.05 for 5m -> rollback to runtime:v2.14
- latency gate: p99 increase >250ms over baseline for 3m -> rollback
- error gate: 5xx >0.3% for 5m -> rollback
Also, if we rollback, run `deploybot rollback runtime v2.14 --cohort canary --tag "quality-regression"` and pin model to reranker-v3.0 until we validate.

lia: agreed. adding one more safety: if rerank-ctr drops >1.5% relative to baseline in 15m, trigger human-in-loop pause (don't auto-rollback).

devops-bot: deploybot: Action queued: hold-unpin runtime v2.15. Manual confirm needed: `@deploybot confirm hold-unpin runtime v2.15 --cohort canary --reason "embedding drift detected" --observ 2700s`

lia: confirming now @deploybot — hold-unpin granted. please route traffic to fallback-models when issuing rollbacks. limit canary to 20% traffic while investigating.

sam: running a differential eval on a 1k sample set and will post results in ~20m. if anyone wants immediate access to the eval harness: https://ci.redwood.internal/evals/17286-diff

sre-oncall: initial 10m check: embedding drop averaged -0.045, rerank-ctr flat, latency stable. not yet at rollback gate.

release-coordinator: reminder: customer-facing release notes should mention temporary hold for runtime v2.15 in AP region and that we're investigating a quality regression; we'll hold off broad rollout until canary clears.

lia: if the differential eval shows the same pattern at +20m we'll prepare rollback steps. logging rollback command here for ops: `deploybot rollback runtime v2.14 --cohort canary --reason "quality regression post v2.15"`

sam: +1. uploading eval snapshot to thread: eval_snapshot_172860_1 (link above).

sre-oncall: will escalate if embedding drop >0.06 or rerank-ctr worsens. keeping pager open.

lia: closing loop: if all gates hold for observation window we'll schedule gradual restore at +60m. will post final decision here. thanks everyone."
